partnershipPlan: Two patient partners and two practice pharmacists review the comment wording and the override route before the pilot.
socialListening: No social media listening; the laboratory's user feedback inbox for the last year is read for comments on repeat testing.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The review is booked every three months, so the blood test goes in two weeks before, whatever the last result was.
items.implication: Align recall systems with the interval and report booked-review overrides separately.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I took the morning off for that test; if it gets held and then run anyway, I have to come back.
items.implication: Count second draws and make overrides possible before the patient is bled.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If I have just started insulin I need to see where she is, and I do not want to argue with a computer.
items.implication: Keep treatment change and pregnancy as one-click override reasons.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: One in six of our HbA1c runs changes nothing for anyone.
items.implication: Report reagent and staff time saved alongside safety.

summary: Four composite voices on recall systems, patient burden, override needs and laboratory workload.
